Wrapper function for the MetaCells2 per-pile parameters

params_sc_metacells2.Rd

Wrapper function for the MetaCells2 per-pile parameters

Usage

params_sc_metacells2(
  target_metacell_size = 48L,
  min_metacell_size = 12L,
  target_metacell_umis = 160000,
  similarity_method = c("abs_pearson", "pearson"),
  log_data = TRUE,
  value_regularisation = 0.142857142857143,
  min_genes = 100L,
  min_gene_total = 50L,
  min_gene_top3 = 4L,
  min_gene_relative_variance = 0.1,
  downsample_min_samples = 750L,
  knn_k_override = NULL,
  min_knn_k = 30L,
  min_gene_fold_factor = 3,
  max_cell_fraction = 0.25,
  gap_skip_cells = 1L,
  min_robust_size_factor = 0.5,
  min_convincing_gene_fold_factor = 3
)

Arguments

target_metacell_size

Integer. Target number of cells per meta cell. Defaults to 48L.

min_metacell_size

Integer. Candidate meta cells below this size are dissolved into outliers. Defaults to 12L.

target_metacell_umis

Numeric. Target total UMIs per meta cell. Drives the number of seeds and the size of the kNN graph. Defaults to 160000.0.

similarity_method

String. Cell-cell similarity on the selected genes. One of c("abs_pearson", "pearson"). Defaults to "abs_pearson".

log_data

Boolean. Correlate log2(x + value_regularisation) instead of x. Defaults to TRUE.

value_regularisation

Numeric. Constant added before the optional log transform. Defaults to 0.14285714285714285.

min_genes

Integer. Floor on the number of selected genes per pile. The relative variance threshold is relaxed until it is met. Defaults to 100L.

min_gene_total

Integer. Minimum total UMIs (downsampled) for a gene to be selected. Defaults to 50L.

min_gene_top3

Integer. Minimum third-highest UMI count of a gene to be selected. Defaults to 4L.

min_gene_relative_variance

Numeric. Minimum windowed relative variance for a gene to be selected. Defaults to 0.1.

downsample_min_samples

Integer. Floor for the per-pile downsampling target. Defaults to 750L.

knn_k_override

Integer or NULL. Fixed k for the balanced kNN graph. NULL derives it from target_metacell_umis and the library sizes. Defaults to NULL.

min_knn_k

Integer. Floor on the derived k. Defaults to 30L.

min_gene_fold_factor

Numeric. Minimum log2 fold gap within a candidate meta cell for a gene to mark cells as deviant. Defaults to 3.0.

max_cell_fraction

Numeric. Upper bound on the fraction of cells marked as deviants. Defaults to 0.25.

gap_skip_cells

Integer. Cells skipped over when measuring a gap. Defaults to 1L.

min_robust_size_factor

Numeric. Multiplier on the target size (and UMIs) above which a meta cell is kept unconditionally. Defaults to 0.5.

min_convincing_gene_fold_factor

Numeric. Minimum log2 fold of any gene for a meta cell below the robust size to be kept anyway. Defaults to 3.0.

Value

A named list with the following elements:

  • target_metacell_size - Integer. Target number of cells per meta cell. Defaults to 48L.

  • min_metacell_size - Integer. Candidate meta cells below this size are dissolved into outliers. Defaults to 12L.

  • target_metacell_umis - Numeric. Target total UMIs per meta cell. Drives the number of seeds and the size of the kNN graph. Defaults to 160000.0.

  • similarity_method - String. Cell-cell similarity on the selected genes. One of c("abs_pearson", "pearson"). Defaults to "abs_pearson".

  • log_data - Boolean. Correlate log2(x + value_regularisation) instead of x. Defaults to TRUE.

  • value_regularisation - Numeric. Constant added before the optional log transform. Defaults to 0.14285714285714285.

  • min_genes - Integer. Floor on the number of selected genes per pile. The relative variance threshold is relaxed until it is met. Defaults to 100L.

  • min_gene_total - Integer. Minimum total UMIs (downsampled) for a gene to be selected. Defaults to 50L.

  • min_gene_top3 - Integer. Minimum third-highest UMI count of a gene to be selected. Defaults to 4L.

  • min_gene_relative_variance - Numeric. Minimum windowed relative variance for a gene to be selected. Defaults to 0.1.

  • downsample_min_samples - Integer. Floor for the per-pile downsampling target. Defaults to 750L.

  • knn_k_override - Integer or NULL. Fixed k for the balanced kNN graph. NULL derives it from target_metacell_umis and the library sizes. Defaults to NULL.

  • min_knn_k - Integer. Floor on the derived k. Defaults to 30L.

  • min_gene_fold_factor - Numeric. Minimum log2 fold gap within a candidate meta cell for a gene to mark cells as deviant. Defaults to 3.0.

  • max_cell_fraction - Numeric. Upper bound on the fraction of cells marked as deviants. Defaults to 0.25.

  • gap_skip_cells - Integer. Cells skipped over when measuring a gap. Defaults to 1L.

  • min_robust_size_factor - Numeric. Multiplier on the target size (and UMIs) above which a meta cell is kept unconditionally. Defaults to 0.5.

  • min_convincing_gene_fold_factor - Numeric. Minimum log2 fold of any gene for a meta cell below the robust size to be kept anyway. Defaults to 3.0.
